recipes.title: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Rolled oats soaked in milk overnight, ready to eat cold in the morning.
steps: Mix oats, milk, and chia seeds in a jar
Stir in honey
Refrigerate overnight
Top with berries before eating

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Toasted sourdough topped with mashed avocado, lemon, and chili flakes.
steps: Toast the bread
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt
Spread on toast
Top with chili flakes

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Pasta
recipes.description: Simple weeknight pasta tossed in a garlic butter parmesan sauce.
steps: Boil pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water
Melt butter, saute garlic until fragrant
Toss pasta in the pan with parmesan and pasta water
Garnish with parsley

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Chicken & Veggies
recipes.description: One-pan roasted chicken thighs with potatoes and vegetables.
steps: Preheat oven to 425F/220C
Toss everything in olive oil and spices on a sheet pan
Roast 35-40 min until chicken is cooked through

recipes.title: Chocolate Mug Cake
recipes.description: A single-serving chocolate cake made in the microwave.
steps: Mix dry ingredients in a mug
Stir in milk and oil until smooth
Microwave 90 seconds
Let cool slightly before eating

recipes.title: Brown Butter Sage Gnocchi
recipes.description: Pillowy gnocchi tossed in nutty brown butter with crispy sage leaves.
steps: Boil gnocchi until they float, drain
Melt butter in a pan until golden and nutty
Fry sage leaves in the butter until crisp
Toss gnocchi in the brown butter, top with parmesan and sage

recipes.title: Miso Caramel Tart
recipes.description: A rich caramel tart with a savory umami edge from white miso.
steps: Melt sugar in a pan until deep amber
Whisk in butter, then cream, off heat
Stir in miso until smooth
Pour into tart shell, chill until set, top with flaky salt
